sloka: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्यां भुजाभ्यामेष शोभते।शृङ्गाभ्यामिव तुङ्गाभ्यां हिमवान् पर्वतोत्तमः ।। ६.७१.२३ ।।
transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadanaddhābhyāṁ bhujābhyāmeṣa śobhate।śṛṅgābhyāmiva tuṅgābhyāṁ himavān parvatottamaḥ ।। 6.71.23 ।।

translations.english: "By adorning armlets, his both arms are like high peaks of Himalaya mountain shining away."
